title: Fee Invoicing, Late Charge and Offset Terms of the Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
The billing figures of the Contingency Placement Agreements differ by tier. This schedule states, for every tier, the figures that govern fee invoices, their due dates, late charges, the monthly minimum fee and the offset of fees against remittances.

## Invoice timing and due date

| Tier | Gross-remit fee invoice issued within (business days after period end) | Fee invoice due (calendar days after invoice date) |
|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 5 | 15 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 5 | 15 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 5 | 30 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 5 | 30 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 3 | 30 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 3 | 45 |

## Late charge figures

- **Late-charge percent per month** — the late charge on a past-due fee invoice for each full month past due, in percent of the unpaid invoice amount.
- **Late-charge grace days** — the calendar days after the invoice due date before a late charge accrues.
- **Late-charge minimum** — the smallest late charge assessed, in USD; 0.00 means no minimum.

| Tier | Late-charge percent per month | Grace days after due date | Late-charge minimum (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 1.5 | 5 | 5.00 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 1.5 | 5 | 5.00 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 1.5 | 10 | 5.00 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 1.0 | 10 | 0.00 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 1.0 | 15 | 0.00 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 1.0 | 15 | 0.00 |

## Monthly minimum fee and offset

- **Minimum monthly fee** — the smallest contingency fee billed for a calendar month with any collections, in USD; 0.00 means no minimum.
- **Offset of fees against remittance** — whether past-due fees may be deducted from the next gross remittance.

| Tier | Minimum monthly fee (USD) | Fees may be offset against remittance |
|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 25.00 | yes |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 0.00 | yes |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 0.00 | yes |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 0.00 | no |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 0.00 | no |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 0.00 | no |

**Hypothetical reading.** On the Preferred Contingency Agreement, an invoice dated on a given day falls due 30 calendar days later, and the 10 grace days run on from the due date. On the Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement the same invoice falls due 45 calendar days after its date and carries 15 grace days.
